'''''UFC 332: Silva vs. Wang''''' was a mixed martial arts event produced by the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] that took place on October 3, 2026, at the [[Delta Center]] in [[Salt Lake City]], Utah, United States.<ref name="SLC">{{Cite web|url=https://www.sportsnet.ca/ufc/article/ufc-332-heading-to-salt-lake-city/|title=UFC 332 heading to Salt Lake City|publisher=sportsnet.ca|author=Staff|date=2026-08-08|access-date=2026-08-09}}</ref>

==Background==
The event marked the promotion's fifth visit to Salt Lake City and first since [[UFC 307]] in October 2024.<ref name="SLC"/> This was the first time the entire main card of a numbered event aired on [[CBS]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/505923/natalia-silva-vs-wang-cong-undisputed-title-fight-set-for-ufc-332-main-event|title=Natalia Silva vs. Wang Cong undisputed title fight set for UFC 332 main event|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Alexander K. Lee|date=2026-09-05|access-date=2026-09-06}}</ref>

A [[UFC Women's Flyweight Championship]] bout for the vacant title between [[Natália Silva (fighter)|Natália Silva]] and [[Wang Cong]] headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/vacant-title-fight-headlines-ufc-332/|title=Vacant title fight headlines UFC 332 in Salt Lake City|publisher=heavy.com|author=Marcel Dorff|date=2026-09-05|access-date=2026-09-06}}</ref> The original championship bout was supposed to be between current two-time champion [[Valentina Shevchenko]] and Silva, which was initially scheduled to serve as the co-main event and later moved to the main event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com.br/mma/ufc/artigo/_/id/17144601/ufc-define-proxima-luta-de-natalia-silva-e-brasileira-ganha-chance-pelo-cinturao|title=UFC define próxima luta de Natália Silva e brasileira ganha chance pelo cinturão|publisher=espn.com.br|author=Davi Garcia and Higor Ciconello|date=2026-08-20|access-date=2026-08-21}} {{in lang|pt-br}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/fannation/mma/news/valentina-shevchenko-could-surpass-amanda-nunes-ufc-332-title-fight|title=Valentina Shevchenko could surpass Amanda Nunes in reported UFC 332 title fight|publisher=si.com|author=Drew Beaupre|date=2026-08-20|access-date=2026-08-21}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.telecomasia.net/news/mma/shevchenko-vs-silva-fight-set-for-ufc-332-on-october-3/|title=Shevchenko vs. Silva fight set for UFC 332 on October 3|publisher=telecomasia.net|author=Telecom Asia Staff|date=2026-08-19|access-date=2026-08-21}}</ref> However, Shevchenko withdrew due to a ligament injury to her back and shoulder that will leave her sidelined for a year, which led to the cancellation of the bout and the title being vacated.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/09/05/ufc-332-natalia-silva-vs-wang-cong-for-interim-title-valentina-shevchenko/91575215007/|title=Natalia Silva vs. Wang Cong flyweight title headlines UFC 332|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Mike Bohn|date=2026-09-05|access-date=2026-09-06}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmasucka.com/news/reports-valentina-shevchenko-out-of-ufc-322-main-event-against-natalia-silva/|title=Reports: Valentina Shevchenko out of UFC 322 main event against Natalia Silva|publisher=mmasucka.com|author=Kishore R|date=2026-09-01|access-date=2026-09-02}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/509041/valentina-shevchenko-coach-reveals-injury-that-forced-shevchenko-to-vacate-flyweight-title|title=Valentina Shevchenko’s coach reveals injury that forced Shevchenko to vacate flyweight title|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Jed Meshew|date=2026-09-07|access-date=2026-09-09}}</ref>

A middleweight bout between former [[UFC Middleweight Championship]] challenger [[Marvin Vettori]] and [[Ismail Naurdiev]] was added to this event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/505714/ufc-332-adds-several-new-bouts-including-johnny-walkers-heavyweight-debut|title=UFC 332 adds several new bouts, including Johnny Walker's heavyweight debut|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Alexander K. Lee|date=2026-08-18|access-date=2026-08-19}}</ref> The pairing had been originally slated for [[UFC Fight Night: Fiziev vs. Torres]] in June, but Vettori was forced to withdraw due to a broken rib, which resulted in the bout's postponement.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Marvin Vettori vs Ismail Naurdiev a UFC Baku il 27 giugno|url=https://www.theshieldofsports.news/marvin-vettori-ismail-naurdiev-ufc-baku/|date=2026-03-26|access-date=2026-08-19|publisher=theshieldofsports.news|author=Francesco Auletta}} {{in lang|it}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Marvin-Vettori-reveals-injury-that-knocked-him-out-of-UFC-Baku-201277|title=Marvin Vettori reveals injury that knocked him out of UFC Baku|publisher=sherdog.com|author=Jay Pettry|date=2026-05-21|access-date=2026-08-19}}</ref>

[[Marcus McGhee]] and Bernardo Sopaj were expected to meet in a bantamweight bout at the preliminary card.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/intriguing-bantamweight-fight-added-ufc-332/|title=Intriguing bantamweight fight added to UFC 332 in Salt Lake City|publisher=heavy.com|author=Marcel Dorff|date=2026-09-05|access-date=2026-09-06}}</ref> However, Sopaj pulled out due to injury just three days before the event and was replaced by promotional newcomer Anthony Romero in a featherweight contest.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/513476/ufc-332-fight-card-marcus-mcghee-books-new-opponent-3-days-from-event|title=UFC 332 fight card: Marcus McGhee books new opponent 3 days from event|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Alexander K. Lee|date=2026-09-30|access-date=2026-09-30}}</ref>

At the weigh-ins, [[Esteban Ribovics]] weighed in at 156.5 pounds, half a pound over the lightweight non-title fight limit. His bout proceeded at catchweight and he was fined 20 percent of his purse, which went to his opponent [[King Green]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/513759/ufc-332-weigh-in-results-1-main-card-fighter-misses-weight|title=UFC 332 weigh-in results: 1 main card fighter misses weight|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Alexander K. Lee|date=2026-10-02|access-date=2026-10-02}}</ref>

==Bonus awards==
The following fighters received $100,000 bonuses. The other finishes received $25,000 additional bonuses.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/ufc-332-bonuses-revealed-action-packed/|title=UFC 332 bonuses revealed following action-packed event|publisher=heavy.com|author=Adam Martin|date=2026-10-03|access-date=2026-10-04}}</ref>
*'''Fight of the Night:''' No bonus awarded.
*'''Performance of the Night: Roman Kopylov''', '''Imanol Rodríguez''', '''Damian Pinas''', and '''Johnny Walker'''

==Records set==
With eleven knockouts, the event broke the UFC record for [[List_of_UFC_records#Most_knockouts_-_In_a_single_event|most knockouts in a single UFC event]], surpassing [[UFC Fight Night: Imavov vs. Borralho]].<ref name="att&gate"/>

The event also broke the modern UFC record for [[List_of_UFC_records#Most_first-round_knockouts_-_In_a_single_event|most first-round knockouts in a single event]] with nine.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mma/story/_/id/50095968/ufc-332-sees-record-9-first-round-knockouts-11-total-finishes|title=UFC 332 sees record 9 first-round knockouts, 11 total finishes|publisher=espn.com|author=Brett Okamoto|date=2026-10-04|access-date=2026-10-04}}</ref>

In addition, the event set records for the most consecutive first-round knockouts with seven, and the most consecutive knockouts in a modern-era UFC event with eight.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://talksport.com/mma/4623311/ufc-332-knockout-record-finishes-results-history-dana-white/|title=UFC 332 smashes records after seven straight first-round knockouts on historic night|publisher=talksport.com|author=Lewis Thompson|date=2026-10-04|access-date=2026-10-04}}</ref>
